_meta.purpose: Manual listing seed data for Offtake OS. Upload a Pinterest image in the farmer app, then create each listing via createListing.

createListingFields.imageStorageId: required — get this after uploading photo in the app (generateListingImageUploadUrl → upload → paste storage id)

workflow: 1. Log in as a farmer on web or mobile.
2. For each listing below, search Pinterest using pinterestImageSearch (or similar keywords).
3. Download a clear product photo (prefer bright, uncluttered produce shots).
4. In the listing form, upload the image and copy the imageStorageId.
5. Fill in crop, county, quantity, price, description, and optional grade.
6. Submit — listing syncs to RAG automatically.

listings.description: Dryland maize harvested this season from Eldoret belt farms. Well-sorted cobs, low moisture, suitable for millers and feed blenders. Bulk sacks available; can arrange pickup from depot.
Mixed-grade maize suitable for posho mills and local wholesalers. Some broken grains; priced accordingly. Fast-moving stock from cooperative members.
Freshly dried maize from western Kenya highlands. Clean, fumigation-ready for export-oriented buyers. Minimum order 500 kg.
Rose coco beans, hand-picked and sun-dried. Uniform size, minimal splits. Popular with supermarkets and school feeding programs in central Kenya.
Navy beans cleaned and bagged for export. Meets basic moisture and defect thresholds. Certificate of origin available on request for registered exporters.
Mixed bean lot — kidney and yellow beans blend. Ideal for hotels and institutional kitchens. Priced for volume buyers; delivery within eastern corridor.
Shangi potatoes from Meru slopes. Firm flesh, good shelf life, washed and graded. Supplying chips makers and fresh-market traders weekly.
Large-tuber potatoes suitable for crisps and wholesale markets. Stored in ventilated crates; low sprouting. Naivasha–Nakuru corridor pickup.
Small-farm organic potatoes, no synthetic pesticides. Irregular sizing but excellent flavor for upscale restaurants and farmers markets in Nairobi.
Ripe round tomatoes from greenhouse blocks near Isinya. Uniform color, firm skin, ideal for supermarkets. Daily harvest during peak season.
Vine-ripened tomatoes for fresh sale and sauce production. Sorted by size; rejects removed. Reliable supply for Nairobi wholesale buyers.
Sweet cherry tomatoes in punnets-ready quality. Targeting hotels and premium retail. Limited weekly volume; pre-order recommended.
Red creole onions, well cured and dry. Long storage potential for traders stocking ahead of school term demand. Bulk nets and sacks.
Spring onions and bulb onions mixed lot for restaurant suppliers in Nairobi CBD. Morning delivery slots available for registered buyers.
Small-sized onions suitable for local markets and informal traders. Some skin blemishes; fully edible. Western Kenya cooperative aggregate.
Glory cabbage heads, tight cores, minimal pest damage. Steady supply for Nakuru and Nairobi route traders. Packed in woven sacks.
Fresh cabbage from highland farms. Crisp leaves, good for coleslaw processors and fresh markets. Harvested within 48 hours of dispatch.
Chinese cabbage (napa) for Asian restaurants and specialty grocers. Tender leaves, hydro-cooled where possible. Growing demand in Nairobi.
Hass avocados, export sizing 16–20 count. Oil content testing available. Packhouse sorting; suitable for EU-oriented exporters with own logistics.
Local-market Hass and Fuerte mix. Ready-to-ripen fruit for supermarkets and juice bars. Brix spot-checks on request.
Smallholder organic avocados from western Kenya. Variable sizing but rich flavor. Ideal for health-food retailers and direct hotel supply.
Nyeri AA green coffee, fully washed. Cupping notes: citrus, blackcurrant, bright acidity. Microlot from member farmers; sample available for serious buyers.
Meru AB green coffee for roasters and exporters. Consistent screen size, moisture within export band. Warehouse storage in Nairobi on arrangement.
Peaberry lot from central Kenya estates. Distinct round beans favored by specialty roasters. Limited quantity; first-come allocation.
Black CTC tea BP1 grade from Rift Valley factories. Brisk liquor, suitable for blenders and packet tea brands. Factory dispatch documents included.
PF1 tea for domestic market packers. Clean leaf, good color. Regular monthly volumes for contracted buyers.
Orthodox whole-leaf tea from small Meru processors. Floral aroma, hand-rolled batches. Niche supply for boutique tea brands.
Milling wheat from North Rift. Protein suitable for bread flour blends. Bulk tonnage; loader access at farm gate.
Feed-grade wheat with slightly higher moisture. Cost-effective for animal feed millers. Stored in silo bags; moisture certificate on request.
Clean wheat for bakers and millers in the Rift. Low foreign matter, tested germination where applicable. Flexible delivery to Nakuru town.
